technical.summary: Oversold conditions present early reversal signals (RSI, StochRSI cross-up) but lack confluence; price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD, weak trend structure (ADX 22.9), and negative money flow—insufficient evidence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: BG shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC event in 1 day creates imminent volatility, and earnings in 36 days add binary event risk—extremely unfavourable environment for Consumer Staples trading.
